decision.trust.label: Trust
decision.trust.description: All deterministic quality checks passed. The result may be relied on subject to routine controls.
decision.trust.next_action: Result may enter clinical workflow under routine controls.
decision.trust.can_rely: Yes — may proceed subject to routine controls.
decision.review.label: Review
decision.review.description: Contextual concerns were detected. A trained operator should review the evidence before the result is relied on.
decision.review.next_action: Hold for trained-operator review; check flagged context before reliance.
decision.verify.label: Verify
decision.verify.description: A hard-stop quality failure was detected. Do not rely on this result alone — repeat or confirm by another method.
decision.verify.next_action: Do not rely — verify/repeat/confirm per applicable workflow.
decision.verify.can_rely: No — do not rely on this result alone.
driver.qc_failed.title: Quality control failed
driver.qc_failed.explanation: The device quality-control check failed, so the result must not be relied on without verification.
driver.qc_failed.action: Do not rely on this result. Resolve and repeat the quality-control check, then repeat the test.
driver.cal_expired.title: Calibration expired
driver.cal_expired.explanation: The device's calibration due date has passed.
driver.cal_expired.action: Do not rely on this measurement until calibration is renewed and the test is repeated.
driver.cal_near_due.title: Calibration due soon
driver.cal_near_due.explanation: The device's calibration is approaching its due date.
driver.cal_near_due.action: Schedule the calibration review at the next opportunity.
driver.reagent_expired.title: Reagent expired
driver.reagent_expired.explanation: The reagent lot has passed its expiry date.
driver.reagent_expired.action: Replace the reagent lot and repeat the test.
driver.reagent_near_expiry.title: Reagent nearing expiry
driver.reagent_near_expiry.explanation: The reagent lot is approaching its expiry date.
driver.reagent_near_expiry.action: Plan to replace the reagent lot before it expires.
driver.operator_not_competent.title: Operator competency not current
driver.operator_not_competent.explanatio: The recorded operator competency is not current for this test.
driver.operator_not_competent.action: A currently competent operator should review this result and repeat the test if required.
driver.env_temp.title: Temperature outside range
driver.env_temp.explanation: The ambient temperature was outside the supported range at the time of the test.
driver.env_temp.action: Restore the supported temperature range, then repeat the test if concerns remain.
driver.env_humidity.title: Humidity outside range
driver.env_humidity.explanation: The ambient humidity was outside the supported range at the time of the test.
driver.env_humidity.action: Restore the supported humidity range, then repeat the test if concerns remain.
driver.power_interruption.title: Power interruption recorded
driver.power_interruption.explanation: A power interruption was recorded around the time of the test.
driver.power_interruption.action: Confirm the device completed its self-check after the interruption; repeat the test if unsure.
driver.provenance_incomplete.title: Provenance incomplete
driver.provenance_incomplete.explanation: One or more provenance fields — operator, reagent lot or location — were not recorded.
driver.provenance_incomplete.action: Record the missing provenance details before this result is relied on.
driver.multi_context.title: Multiple contextual concerns
driver.multi_context.explanation: Several contextual concerns apply to this result at the same time.
driver.multi_context.action: Review the combined concerns with a trained operator before relying on this result.
driver.all_checks_pass.title: All checks passed
driver.all_checks_pass.action: No action required — proceed subject to routine controls.

ui.app.tagline: Deterministic rules authoritative · AI advisory only.
ui.language.label: Language
ui.language.supported_note: English is the canonical source. Other languages are previews until reviewed.
ui.preview.note: Not yet reviewed by clinical linguists.
ui.hero.do_not_rely: Do not rely on this result alone.
ui.ai.subtitle: AI-assisted explanation based on recorded quality evidence — advisory only, below deterministic reasoning.
ui.ai.english_only: Contextual Analysis is currently available in English.
ui.ai.review_authoritative: Review remains the authoritative decision — this note does not change it.
ui.ai.summary_only: Stored record keeps the advisory summary only — no confidence score or model name was persisted for this assessment.
